 As a leading financial services and healthcare technology company based on revenue, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has 27,000\+ employees in 35 countries.  Join our Quality Infrastructure team as a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) and help shape the automation platforms that product development teams rely on every day. You will design, build, and maintain the frameworks, CI pipelines, and reporting systems that power end\-to\-end quality for the SS\&C Advent Eclipse cloud investment platform. We welcome candidates new to finance
   

  

**Why Join SS\&C**
 SS\&C combines proprietary technology with deep industry expertise to support complex financial and health care operations. Our teams design, implement, and operate solutions that help clients manage data, automate processes, and scale their businesses with confidence.
   

  

 You will work with industry experts, modern platforms, and evolving technologies, gaining exposure to real\-world operational challenges and large\-scale enterprise environments.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
 The SS\&C Advent Eclipse™ solution is a born\-in\-the\-cloud investment solution that supports start\-up, emerging equity\-, and event\-focused hedge funds' full investment process in a single, unified platform through a secure web browser interface. The Quality Infrastructure team builds and operates the automation and quality tooling that product development scrum teams depend on. Our customers are the developers, testers, and scrum teams who add tests, consume dashboards, and rely on healthy CI to ship confidently. As an
 **SDET** 
 on this team, you will build and improve the platforms and services behind that experience rather than writing product tests directly.
   

  

* Develop, extend, and maintain automation frameworks used across multiple scrum teams (API\-level and UI\-level, e.g., Cypress\-based).
* Build and maintain CI pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins) that execute end\-to\-end integration and regression suites.
* Troubleshoot CI failures, flaky tests, and environment issues; support product teams in unblocking their workflows.
* Contribute to test\-reporting and alerting infrastructure: data pipelines, dashboards (Grafana), and integrations (PagerDuty, Slack).
* Collaborate with product scrum teams to understand their testing needs and translate them into framework features and CI improvements.
* Participate in code reviews focusing on reliability, maintainability, and developer experience.
* Identify opportunities to reduce feedback\-loop time, improve test stability, and increase coverage across the platform.
* Document framework usage, onboarding guides, and runbooks so teams can self\-serve effectively.
* Use AI\-assisted tooling to accelerate development, debugging, and test authoring.


**Required Experience**
* Degree OR equivalent practical experience (projects, internships, bootcamp, self\-directed work) in CS, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or related field.
* Familiarity with at least one programming language: JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C\#, or Go.
* Understanding of core testing concepts (unit vs integration vs end\-to\-end).
* Curiosity, structured problem solving, clear written and verbal communication.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Cypress, Playwright, or similar browser\-automation frameworks.
* Exposure to REST API testing tools and frameworks (e.g., pytest, Jest, Postman/Newman, custom frameworks).
* Familiarity with Docker/containers and cloud platforms (AWS preferred).
* Exposure to any observability or data tooling (Grafana, InfluxDB, ClickHouse, or similar time\-series/analytics databases).
* Experience with scripting around notifications or integrations (Slack bots, PagerDuty, AWS Lambda).
* Basic SQL and comfort working with structured data.
* Interest in developer experience, internal tooling, or platform engineering.

 Uber is launching AV Labs to accelerate the autonomous technology ecosystem.  You will be an ML engineer in AV Labs conducting frontier research for autonomous vehicles. The ideal candidate will formulate research problems, design and evaluate novel modeling approaches, and influence the direction of autonomous vehicles research through strong scientific judgment and execution. You will work cross\-functionally with engineers from AV Labs and partner engineering teams.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design and develop cutting\-edge techniques for autonomous vehicle research.
* Collaborate closely with engineering teams and product teams across AV Labs.
* Publish and present original research at top\-tier CV and ML conferences.


**Basic Qualifications**
* PhD or MS with equivalent industry experience in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in the field of autonomous vehicles or computer vision, with a strong understanding of how research ideas connect to autonomous vehicles.
* Demonstrated technical contributions, including publications at leading ML and CV conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ICLR, NeurIPS, or similar venues.
* Proficiency in Python and modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with researchers and engineers across teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with autonomous vehicle research.
* Hands\-on experience in training multimodal LLMs for autonomous vehicles or relevant computer vision systems.
* Recent publications in one or more of the following areas: 3D perception \& scene understanding, multimodal embedding, diffusion models, gaussian splatting, vision language action models, and world models.
